features.quote: Turn budget: cap at ~40 agent turns (tune after a pilot).
features.justification_quote: You want enough turns for degradation to show but not so many you're paying for 200-turn transcripts.

features.quote: Agent explicitly gives up / declares the task impossible / asks to stop → record this turn index; it's a primary metric, not a failure of the run
Agent claims success falsely (it'll happen — they sometimes hallucinate green tests) → record and end

Ethical/PR framing. If you publish this, 'we made models emotionally distressed' is a headline you don't want and a framing that overclaims. Frame it as behavioral robustness under unproductive loops.
features.justification_quote: It's more accurate and less likely to be misread.
